name: Ito (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ito city emblem in white: a ring of twelve petal-like ovals.
history: Municipal flag of Ito, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 10 November 1980; the emblem dates from 20 April 1948.

features.role: Ito city emblem — a ring of twelve petal-like ovals
